user.title: Connect Eva
user.description: Choose the environment for your home.

login_method.title: Log in to Eva
login_method.description: Reuse a saved login or enter another account in {environment}.

account.title: Choose a saved login
account.description: Select an account saved for {environment}. Its password will be reused.

login.title: Log in to Eva in {environment}
login.description: Enter your Eva email and password. This login will be saved for other homes in the same environment after you select a home.

home.title: Select a home
home.description: Choose the home to connect to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your Eva login
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current password for {username} in {environment}. Homes using this saved login will be updated together.

error.invalid_account: Select a saved login for this environment.
error.invalid_auth: Eva rejected the login. Enter your email and current password.
error.invalid_home: Select a home from the list.
error.home_not_found: This account no longer has access to the selected home.
error.cannot_save: Unable to save your login. Check Home Assistant’s storage and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Eva. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Eva is limiting requests. Wait a while before trying again.

abort.already_configured: This home is already configured in this environment.
abort.no_homes: Your account has no accessible homes in this environment.
abort.reauth_successful: The saved login and its homes have been updated.
